title: Apply for an on-premises licence (cafe or restaurant)
summary: This page provides information on applying for an on-premises liquor licence for a cafe or restaurant that serves food and alcohol.
intro:
An on-premises liquor licence lets you supply alcohol along with the food service at your cafe or restaurant.

The main activity of your business must be the preparation and serving of meals to the public.

You will need separate applications if you require:

For up-to-date liquor licence guidelines, resources and tools visit Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing.

If you have questions or feedback about liquor licensing contact Liquor & Gaming NSW.
who_can_apply: Must be at least 18 years old.
what_you_need: A MyServiceNSW Account or OneGov account
A floor plan showing the boundaries proposed for the licensed premises
Contact details for you or another authorised person
A copy of your Development Approval or Consent (if applicable)
A completed Licence conditions form: on-premises
A completed Primary Service Authorisation (if required)
Evidence of Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) qualification and Licensee and Advanced Licensee training (if applicable)
A current National Police Check certificate issued within the last 3 months
The 3 identity documents used when applying for the National Police Check
The names and birthdates of all directors and officeholders (if it is a proprietary company)
A current Australian Securities and Investments Commission (ASIC) extract
Details of an appointed Approved Manager (if applicable)
If applying as an individual, you must provide specific details.
If applying as an organisation, you must provide specific details.

how_to_steps.text: Sign in to your account or register for a MyServiceNSW Account.
Follow the prompts to complete your application.

more_info.text: Some liquor licence applications require you to notify stakeholders and the local community about your application once it has been submitted.
Find out more about notification requirements at Liquor & Gaming NSW.

Conditions apply to NSW liquor licences. Some conditions apply automatically depending on the type of premises. Other conditions may be imposed on a licence by Liquor & Gaming NSW or the Independent Liquor & Gaming Authority.
Where there are conditions that may be applied, you can include the conditions form with your application. It may help reduce application processing time.
Find out more about licence conditions at Liquor & Gaming NSW.

faqs.q: What is an on-premises liquor licence?
faqs.a: An on-premises liquor licence allows you to supply alcohol along with the food service at your cafe or restaurant.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this licence?
faqs.a: To be eligible, you must be at least 18 years old.

faqs.q: Where can I find more information about liquor licensing?
faqs.a: For up-to-date guidelines, resources, and tools, visit the Liquor & Gaming NSW liquor licensing page.
